items.title: Red Flags That Expose Fake North Korean IT Workers
items.description: North Korean operatives posing as IT workers are improving their tactics, but researchers say there are still ways to spot them before they do damage.

items.title: New GPUThor attack defeats NVIDIA ECC protection for root access
items.description: A newly disclosed Rowhammer attack called GPUThor can bypass error-correcting code (ECC) protections on NVIDIA GPUs, enabling denial-of-service (DoS) and root-level privilege escalation. [...]

items.title: 21 Critical Ubiquiti UniFi Flaws Enable Authentication Bypass, Command Injection and Privilege Escalation
items.description: Ubiquiti has patched 21 critical-severity vulnerabilities spanning nearly its entire UniFi product line, warning that attackers with only network access could chain the flaws to bypass authentication, inject commands, and seize full control of routers, cameras, access-control systems, and cloud gateways. items.title: Critical Next.js Vulnerabilities Enables Remote Code Execution Attacks
items.description: Two critical Next.js flaws allow unauthenticated remote code execution on Windows-hosted applications using the Image Optimization API to process AVIF images. The first flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-75604, affects Next.js applications that use either the Pages Router or the App Router without Cache Components. items.title: Android Malware Hijacks Update System for Car Head Units
items.description: Threat actors behind a notorious click-fraud botnet have set their sights on vehicle infotainment modules and are abusing legitimate functionality to spread infections.

items.title: FBI Disrupts China-Linked QTFY Infrastructure Used to Steal Data From U.S. Organizations
items.description: The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) on Wednesday announced the disruption of two hacking platforms named QScan and QTRouter operated by Chinese threat actors to target critical infrastructure and other sensitive networks in the country. The accounts produced social-media posts and replies designed to steer people toward the International Burke Institute, or IBI, a purported Israeli expert community. items.title: Snowflake ends service-account passwords. Now comes the hard part
items.description: Snowflake is ending password authentication for legacy service accounts, forcing organizations to migrate them to passwordless methods. Token Security explains why the harder challenge is identifying what uses each account, who owns it, and how much access it still needs. [...]

items.title: Unpatched Kaltura mwEmbed Flaws Could Let Remote Attackers Read Files and Run Code
items.description: The CERT Coordination Center (CERT/CC) has disclosed two unpatched vulnerabilities in Kaltura's HTML5 video player library that allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to read arbitrary files from a server and execute code on it.
